preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.
The value of k must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string must be equal to the length of S minus the corrected value of k.
The output string must be the lexicographically smallest string formed by removing k_corrected characters from S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if k_corrected > len(S) else True
postconditions.description: If k_corrected is greater than the length of S, the output must be '-1'.
